original_test_intent: Validate the configured DIMM voltage-regulator temperature sensor through its warning and critical thresholds, confirm BMC WebUI/IPMI agreement and SEL threshold events, and return the assembly safely to its normal thermal range.
original_method: A qualified hardware operator positions a controlled heat source at the identified DIMM VR while an independent calibrated probe and the agent's read-only BMC/IPMI telemetry establish temperature-versus-time. Pause at the approved TWarning boundary for event capture; proceed toward TCritical only under separate authorization and a defined stop-before-damage limit, then remove heat, restore cooling and verify sensor deassertion and health.
manual_activity: A qualified operator must identify and shield the exact VR, control heat-gun distance/angle/rate, respond to the independent probe, pause/remove heat at approved gates, inspect for damage and manage cooling. Agent monitoring never replaces that physical control.
required_inputs: Board/DIMM assembly revision and exact VR/sensor/SEL mapping
Authoritative TWarning/TCritical values, hysteresis and BMC-WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance
Heat-gun model, nozzle, fixture, distance, angle, ramp rate and maximum dwell/temperature
Ambient/cooling/load configuration, emergency stop/isolation and recovery/deassertion plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with qualified operator, shielding and calibrated independent temperature measurement
Establish sensor agreement before heat and preserve existing logs
Never direct uncontrolled airflow at DIMM, connector, PCB or adjacent device
Stop immediately for rapid rise, disagreement, smoke/odor/noise, discoloration, cooling/power anomaly or limit breach
No automatic retry; cool and inspect fully before any engineer-authorized repeat
agent_execution_scope: Collect baseline and timestamped BMC WebUI/IPMI/OS/SEL telemetry and identify threshold transitions
Do not aim/control a heat gun, choose thresholds, authorize crossing TCritical, power-cycle damaged hardware or set PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve target map, threshold/tolerance and exact heating envelope
Decide whether reaching TCritical is required or a stop boundary and define expected assertion/deassertion events
Clarify `reasonable range`, cross-interface timing tolerance and whether throttling/protective action is in scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The read-only grep/SDR fragment is only supplementary monitoring: it omits WebUI and SEL exports, discards sensor context, assumes an OS thermal message, cannot control physical heat, and invents a throttling expectation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved continuous read-only BMC/IPMI telemetry and full SEL export during the operator-controlled thermal ramp; keep heat application as a human procedure, not an agent command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two-stage TWarning then TCritical intent and 10/5-minute estimates are preserved; numerical temperatures, tolerance and ramp are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Mount a calibrated probe at the mapped VR, synchronize it with raw BMC/IPMI sensor samples and SEL stream, use a fixed shielded heating geometry, hold briefly at TWarning for assertion evidence, require explicit authorization before the critical boundary, then capture deassertion and post-cooling health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds independent metrology, controlled geometry, abort gates and recovery evidence while preserving the physical threshold stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Telemetry without heating does not test threshold handling; heating without calibrated correlation cannot prove sensor accuracy or safe threshold crossing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Localized hot air can overshoot the sensor, damage the VR/DIMM/PCB or heat adjacent parts before BMC telemetry updates.

project_override_considerations: The hybrid case is not MANUAL ONLY because automated telemetry correlation is meaningful, but physical heat remains strictly operator-owned and requires explicit confirmation. Missing fixture/threshold inputs block execution, not the review.
expected_evidence: Owner approval, SUT/board/DIMM/VR/sensor identity and annotated target photo
Calibrated probe/heat fixture details and approved limits
Timestamped ambient, independent probe, BMC WebUI and IPMI readings with computed agreement
TWarning and authorized TCritical assertion plus SEL records and hysteresis/deassertion
Heat/cooling timeline, physical inspection, post-test health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `Reasonable range`, interface equality and allowed tolerance are undefined; no numerical TWarning/TCritical, ramp or stop limit is supplied; and Criteria do not say whether both thresholds/events are mandatory even though Procedure instructs heating through both.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target activity and desired sensor/SEL behavior are identifiable. Board-specific thresholds, fixture limits, monitoring and recovery are expected engineering inputs, so the review class remains package/user-confirmed while execution waits.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 12 Wistron-System RAS-00732-V003: approve board/DIMM-VR/sensor/SEL mapping; numerical TWarning/TCritical, hysteresis and WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance; heat-gun/fixture geometry, ramp/dwell/maximum temperature and aborts; decide whether TCritical crossing and any throttling/protection are required; define assertion/deassertion, cooling, inspection and recovery acceptance.

review_improvement: This review separates sensor-threshold coverage from an unsupported throttling claim and turns a hazardous freehand heat instruction into measurable, bounded evidence requirements without changing the source test purpose.
independent_technical_reasoning: A DIMM VR sensor can lag the silicon or package hotspot, while a heat gun creates steep gradients and warms neighboring components. Therefore the BMC reading cannot itself control safe stimulus; a calibrated local probe, fixed geometry and conservative stop boundary are necessary. Equality between WebUI and IPMI usually means the same BMC source and needs a numerical tolerance and timestamp window, not literal simultaneous equality. The source asks to pass TWarning toward TCritical but does not define whether the critical event must be asserted or merely approached. These resolvable engineering inputs support REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, with no autonomous heating or inferred threshold.
